text:
Type: tall white glass-door cabinet
Use: displaying china, glassware or books; dining room, living room
Style: traditional, classic, farmhouse
Materials: white painted wood, clear glass doors and sides, glass shelves, small metal knobs, beadboard back
Colors: white, clear glass
Shape: tall upright vitrine with a molded crown, two glass doors divided into three panes, glass side panels, curved plinth base, stately and light
Feel: bright, elegant, timeless, fresh
Goes with: white or pale grey walls, silver or nickel, blue and white china; classic, traditional or farmhouse dining rooms

product.name: LIATORP
product.description: 3 adjustable glass shelves; adjust spacing according to your own storage needs.
